learning_outcomes.text: To introduce some of the organic-based processes used in the conversion of chemical raw materials into useful products.
Better understanding of the basic principles and features of organic processes.
Facilitating students' adaptation to the industrial environment.

syllabus_topics: Coking of Coal and Coal Chemicals. Revealing Chemical Processes with Their Universal and Social Health, Environment and Safety Effects
Coking of Coal and Coal Chemicals

Berg, F.J., Jong, W.A., Introduction to Chemical Process Technology, Delf University Press, Delf, 1983.
Moulijn, J.A., Makkee, M., Van Diepen, A., Chemical Process Technology, John Wiley&Sons, 2001.
Shreve, R.N., Brink, J.A., Chemical Process Industries, McGraw Hill, 1977.
